title: A fourth interstellar object
statement: Exhibit an interstellar object other than 1I/'Oumuamua, 2I/Borisov and 3I/ATLAS: ground-based optical astrometry spanning at least 30 days from at least two stations, fitted under full planetary perturbations, whose barycentric osculating eccentricity exceeds 1.02 by at least three standard deviations.
witness_format: JSON object: designation (string), orbit {q, e, i, node, peri, tp, epoch} (heliocentric ecliptic J2000, degrees, JD TDB), observations (list of MPC 80-column optical lines, ground-based only), optional sigma_arcsec (assumed per-observation error, default 1.0)
